ValidationRule.description: #21306- Restrict users from editing Billing country once Opportunity is Closed Won
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( ISCHANGED( Billing_Country__c ), OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, '5 - Signed/PO in'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, '6 - Setup'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, '7 - Closed')), NOT( ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE(StageName), '4 - Negotiate') ),
$Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> 'IM_Custom Sys Admin',
NOT($Permission.Edit_Billing_Country_in_Late_Stage_Opp), NOT($Permission.VR_Bypass_Permission)
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot update the Billing Country once an Opportunity has been Won. Need help? Contact your Sales Operations Business Partner.
